name: Stonemaul Hold
summary: Stonemaul Hold is a fortified ogre mound outpost situated southwest of Dire Maul in Feralas. Inhabited by ogres of the Horde-allied Stonemaul clan, the stronghold serves as a forward base against the hostile Gordunni ogres of the region.

sections.title: A Horde Foothold in the Wilds
sections.body: Nestled beneath the dense canopy of Feralas southwest of the ruins of Dire Maul, Stonemaul Hold stands as a rare sign of ogre loyalty to the Horde. Led by Orhan Ogreblade, the Stonemaul clan here works to secure the surrounding wilderness against rival factions. Their primary campaign focuses on subduing the aggressive Gordunni ogres who dominate nearby ruins and squander valuable territory and resources. By breaking Gordunni power, the Stonemaul seek to claim those resources for the Horde's greater survival.

aliases: what is this ogre camp feralas
faq.answer: It is an outpost of the Stonemaul clan ogres located southwest of Dire Maul in Feralas. Unlike hostile ogre dens across Kalimdor, this fortified mound serves the Horde.

aliases: who is in charge of stonemaul hold
faq.answer: The outpost is led by Orhan Ogreblade, who directs the local Stonemaul ogres in their tactical strikes across the forest.

faq.q: Why are the Stonemaul fighting other ogres in Feralas?
faq.answer: The local Gordunni clan claims vast territory and ruins while hoarding essential resources. Orhan Ogreblade and the Stonemaul fight to bring down the Gordunni so the Horde can claim and utilize what their savage rivals waste.

faq.q: Are the ogres here hostile to Horde travelers?
faq.answer: No. The Stonemaul clan is allied with the Horde, offering a safe waypoint and flight connections for Horde adventurers traversing central Feralas.

angles.text: Stonemaul Hold provides a vital strategic bastion in central Feralas, serving as an ally-controlled buffer against the brutish Gordunni tribe.
